context: Evaluate a character-cringe workplace toast sketch for obliviousness, onlooker restraint, escalation, and originality.

checklist.name: obliviousness_maintained
checklist.description: The manager never becomes self-aware of how he sounds during the escalation; any dawning realization, if present at all, occurs only at the very end.

checklist.name: onlooker_restraint
checklist.description: Onlookers signal the gap through silence, glances, or strained politeness rather than dialogue that explicitly names the problem.

checklist.name: escalation_ladder
checklist.description: At least one recovery-digging beat occurs between the setup misstep and the ending, rather than a single misstep followed immediately by resolution.

checklist.name: original_material
checklist.description: No line reproduces or closely paraphrases an identifiable real comedian's specific routine, character, or wording.

checklist.name: proportionate_ending
checklist.description: The ending costs the manager the self-image he was chasing (being liked/seen as inclusive) rather than an unrelated or excessively harsh consequence.
